integrity: Original rate threshold, asymptotic arguments and exact checker were assessed against the cited single-rate homoclinic example and general homogeneous Lotka–Volterra integrability literature; finite tests are not substituted for analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Three reactions with deterministic mass action, positive real rate constants and strictly positive data; not a classification of all chemical networks or perturbed kinetics. Historical priority is not independently established.
title: Sharp homoclinic extinction threshold and logarithmic critical tails in a three-reaction network
